Subject: Follow-up: Decision Canvas & Enablement Checklist — Meridian Pilot

Thanks again for your time today — solid conversation and a helpful demo run-through. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap (short):
- Use case: real-time inference for customer insights (30–90s transaction windows) + nightly batch re-embedding.
- Primary decision criteria you called out: latency SLA, predictable per-token cost, and integration with your on-prem data lake.
- Key stakeholders mentioned: Tom (exec/econ buyer), Priya Rao (security/legal), procurement@meridian.ai (procurement). Please confirm any additional names/emails.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the full stakeholder list (names + emails) for procurement and security so we can tailor the SOW and security pack?
2) I'm attaching a Decision Canvas (v0) and a quick ROI scenarios workbook — review and tell us which ROI assumptions you want refined.
3) Proposed next call: procurement + legal + our contracts lead on Fri 2026-01-22 09:00 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a short agenda.
4) Champion enablement: Tom sounded like a strong internal sponsor — we’ll prepare a one-pager with 3x talk tracks (exec, engineering, procurement) and an ROI snapshot for him to use in internal briefing.

Attachments (stubs): Decision_Canvas_Meridian_v0.pdf (decision map), Meridian_ROI_Scenarios_v1.xlsx (assumptions + back-of-envelope).

If any of the above items need to be adjusted, let me know. I’ll assume Friday 1/22 unless I hear otherwise and will loop in our contracts and security reps.

Best,
Michael Grant

Internal quick notes for the enablement artifacts (Michael/Ben/Olga):

1) Champion one-pager (attached): three short talk tracks for Tom —
   - Executive: highlight predictable unit economics, 30% lower per-query cost vs current host, and single-dashboard visibility across hosted/dedicated modes.
   - Eng/Platform: emphasize KV-cache impact on latency, supported quantized variants, and our on-prem connector options for data residency.
   - Procurement: clear SOW inputs, monthly reserved vs usage options, and 60-day termination with {transition play}.

2) ROI bullets to call out during Tom briefing: expected TCO reduction scenarios (Base: 18% TCO savings, Aggressive: 32%), payback windows by pilot size, and a simple sensitivity table (QPS | avg tokens | months to payback). I put the high-level numbers into the ROI workbook — flag any assumptions you want tightened.

3) Security/compliance ask: Priya will want SOC2 evidence and an architecture diagram showing VPC peering/encryption at rest. Ben — can you prepare a one-page security evidence pack and mark items that require legal sign-off?

I attached a Champion_OnePager_Meridian.pdf draft — please review edits inline and keep the language concise.

Short and tactical — we should be ready to drive Tom’s internal briefing by Tues 1/20 so they can loop legal before our Friday sync.

-Marissa
